ai.rationale: Sharp, specific pitch: vision-only race-engineer coaching for karting/moto/cycling with timestamped braking and racing-line feedback — a real differentiator vs sensor-based products. Genuine multimodal AI leverage (Gemini 2.5 Flash for video + Groq LLaMA), all three URLs filled in (Vimeo + repo + Streamlit deploy). Loses a point because the demo is a single-flow Streamlit app rather than something with sample outputs or evaluation built in, but for a one-day build this is well-scoped and clearly shipped.
